snippet.title: Mesmalie demo trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534790/Mesmalie/

Follow me on Bluesky for updates! https://bsky.app/profile/orbitaldot.com

MESMALIE is an occult hybrid visual novel/point & click adventure in which you attempt to tame a newfound Magickal ability under the guidance of a witches' Coven.

I'm releasing a demo on August 2, just to put something of it out there ,,,
